title: J--FTSS III Unrestricted MAC Task Order Notice of Tentative Acquisition Strategy Program Title: Chief of Naval Air Training (CNATRA) Contractor Operation and Maintenance Services (COMS)
description_text: FTSS III Unrestricted MAC Task Order Notice of Tentative Acquisition Strategy Program Title: Chief of Naval Air Training (CNATRA) Contractor Operation and Maintenance Services (COMS) Description: Naval Air Warfare Center Training Systems intends to competitively award a Firm Fixed Price Task Order under FTSS III for Contractor Operation and Maintenance Services (COMS) and Contractor Maintenance Services (CMS) in support of Chief of Naval Air training (CNATRA) at NAS Corpus Christi, TX, NAS Kingsville, TX, NAS Whiting Field, FL, NAS Pensacola, FL, and NAS Meridian, MS. The period of performance is 59 months, inclusive of two (2) month mobilization and one (1) seven (7) month base year with four (4) twelve (12) month options and one (1) two (2) month option. Start of contractor performance will be 01 April 2017. RFP Number: N61340-16-R-1146 Contracting Officer: Ms. Kathleen Dougherty Phone: 407-380-8189 Email: kathleen.dougherty@navy.mil Contract Specialist: Ms. Roxanne Wiseman Phone: 407-380-8024 Email: roxanne.wiseman@navy.mil COMS Manager: Mr. Skip Hemrick Phone: 407- 380-4211 Email: william.d.hemrick@navy.mil Anticipated RFP Release Date: July 2016 Anticipated Award Date: January 2017 Anticipated Acquisition Strategy: Competitive under FTSS III Unrestricted MAC Other Information: Predecessor Contract: N61340-12-C-5601, Fidelity Technologies Corporation The Service Contract Act is applicable. Be advised that the aforementioned information is anticipatory in nature and is not binding. Further information will be provided, as it becomes know
